feed.title: KGX's Admin Toolbox releases
feed.subtitle: Every release of KGX's Admin Toolbox for Garry's Mod.

entry.title: KGX's Admin Toolbox v3.6.21.6.1: KGX Menu, Logic & NPC Editor
entry.summary: New: the toolbox in Q menu > Utilities > KGX A KGX's Admin Toolbox page next to KGX Core's pages: the version, buttons into the toolbox tab (Setup Wizard, README, Translations) and the main server switches (superadmins). One theme for every KGX addon (needs KGX Core 1.3.3) The to
entry.content:
New: the toolbox in Q menu > Utilities > KGX

  • A KGX's Admin Toolbox page next to KGX Core's pages: the version, buttons into the toolbox tab (Setup Wizard, README, Translations) and the main server switches (superadmins).

One theme for every KGX addon (needs KGX Core 1.3.3)

  • The toolbox's eight dark-menu themes are KGX themes: pick one on the KGX Core page and the spawn menu, KGX windows and KGX screens all use it.
  • Dark menus, brightness and colored text moved to the KGX Core page. Settings > Display keeps tool tips, the version line and the hover preview.

One translation editor (needs KGX Core 1.3.3)

  • The toolbox's phrases are on KGX Translations with every KGX addon's. Your existing toolbox edits and languages move there once (a copy is kept in the data folder).
  • Only the server owner (or superadmins while no owner is set) changes phrases, as before. Settings > Translations points to the new page. Edits or languages KGX Core has no room for stay with the toolbox and keep working.

Logic for every part of the toolbox (World > Logic)

  • Six new event nodes (admins): Economy (paychecks, store sales, property, treasury, robberies), Police & Mayor (wanted, warrants, jail, cuffs, lockdowns, laws), Staff (reports, warnings, bans, any admin action), Day / night & weather, Progression & server (levels, votes, server mode), Phone & player activity.
  • The Match watcher has OnWaveStart and OnWaveCleared (Waves): e.g. clear corpses and decals between waves.
  • New actions: money (wallet, bank, treasury, cash), open a menu (F3 hub, loadout, backpack, phone, bank, store...), police and Mayor, time and weather, every door, lights, media players and radios, fireworks, lightning, NPC orders, mail, Action Log lines, kick (superadmins).
  • The Player action does much more (XP, buffs, revive, invisible, gag, warn, noclip...), Admin can remove corpses, lock the server, make a backup, and there are 17 new "Only if" conditions (wanted, night, weather, level...).
  • Safe by default: loops through events, delays, the clock and noclip stop, a node's bank or store opens only near it for 5 minutes, players' nodes open one window per 10 seconds, and timed states never undo an admin's.
  • Fix: the Game mode action was missing from the output editor's action list.

NPC Editor: one page for everything about an NPC (AI > NPC Editor, UPDATE)

  • Left click an NPC (or Edit... in AI > NPC AI): a new page with a turning preview and tabs: General, Loadout, Look, Combat, Death & loot, Type options, AI.
  • Look: model (admins), skin, body groups, color and see-through, material, blood. The preview changes as you go.
  • Combat: friendly / neutral / hostile / afraid toward players, holds its position, god mode, damage it takes and does, health back per second, sight distance.
  • Death & loot: a loot table bag at its body, a cash drop, money for whoever kills it, comes back after a time with the same settings, body fade, weapon drop.
  • Type options: quiet, health kit drop, cannot be pushed; citizen medic and ammo giver, Combine grenades and tactics, Metro Police manhacks.
  • Apply keeps the page open, Copy / Paste settings to other NPCs, and Save to map (admins): it comes back after every restart with everything set on the page.
  • Players given the tool still edit only their own NPCs, with the look, loadout and AI; the rest is for admins (loot and money also for the NPC AI panel with the Money tool).
  • NPC Editor and Logic show an UPDATE tag in the tool list until you open them.

Fix

  • A spawn-menu hook returned a value, which in Garry's Mod stops the other map-start hooks: depending on their order, the toolbox's translation edits, owner list, weather and economy timers could be skipped (since v3.5.36).
  • Mayor laws: a law starting or ending with the digit 0 lost it ("Speed limit 50" became "Speed limit 5").

Without KGX Core 1.3.3 the Display and Translations pages work as before. No other tool changed.

entry.title: KGX's Admin Toolbox v3.6.21.6: On KGX Core
entry.summary: On KGX Core The toolbox now uses KGX Core , the shared library of the KGX addons (a required item on the Workshop). It is listed in Q menu > Utilities > KGX > KGX Core, which shows a note when a newer version is on the Workshop. One language for every KGX addon : the toolbox's la
entry.content:
On KGX Core

  • The toolbox now uses KGX Core, the shared library of the KGX addons (a required item on the Workshop). It is listed in Q menu > Utilities > KGX > KGX Core, which shows a note when a newer version is on the Workshop.
  • One language for every KGX addon: the toolbox's language and the server default are the same as KGX Core's (kgxat_lang = kgx_lang, kgxat_language = kgx_language). Changing either changes both; a server's existing toolbox settings are kept.
  • The NEW / UPDATE tags setting and the net budget are shared too: kgxat_new_badges = kgx_tags, kgxat_net_budget = kgx_net_budget (one per-second limit for every KGX addon's messages; the toolbox's 100 stays on).
  • Other KGX addons' admin actions (Throw Equipped, Pickup Equipped settings...) appear in the toolbox's Action Log and Discord logs, tagged with the addon's name.
  • Without KGX Core the toolbox works as before; superadmins get a chat line asking to subscribe to it.
  • No change to any tool, panel or setting. Data stays in garrysmod/data/kgx_admin_toolbox/.

entry.title: KGX's Admin Toolbox v3.6.21.5.1: Alt + E Buttons
entry.summary: Alt + E for admins The Access window (Alt + E) now has buttons for the thing's own windows: Money Generator, eye scanner settings, vault, shipment, talking NPC, phone book, property. Treasury nodes, stores, banks, ATMs, phone booths and talking NPCs: Alt + E opens a window of the
entry.content:
Alt + E for admins

  • The Access window (Alt + E) now has buttons for the thing's own windows: Money Generator, eye scanner settings, vault, shipment, talking NPC, phone book, property.
  • Treasury nodes, stores, banks, ATMs, phone booths and talking NPCs: Alt + E opens a window of their buttons (open the treasury, robbery settings, screen settings, store editor, open the store).

Treasury nodes

  • Fix: right click with the Treasury Node tool opens the robbery settings (Money Generator) again; the screen is E + right click. Each window opens the other.
  • Live income on the screen (on by default): updates within a second of every change and shows it for a few seconds ("+$250 Sales tax").

entry.title: KGX's Admin Toolbox v3.6.21.5: Screens
entry.summary: New: screens for the treasury and stores Treasury nodes are now a monitor by default with the treasury on its screen : the full page (balance, amount in words, in today, the latest changes) or just the amount . Right-click a node with the Treasury Node tool for its screen. Who se
entry.content:
New: screens for the treasury and stores

  • Treasury nodes are now a monitor by default with the treasury on its screen: the full page (balance, amount in words, in today, the latest changes) or just the amount. Right-click a node with the Treasury Node tool for its screen.
  • Who sees it: everyone, or admins, Treasury jobs and the ranks and players you pick; the others see a locked screen or just the amount (by default: just the amount).
  • A HIDE / SHOW button at the bottom right of every screen: E on it hides the screen for everyone (admins and Treasury jobs, or everyone who may see it).
  • Store screens: Store Maker > Screen tab. The store is a screen (pick a monitor, TV or cash register model) or has a screen beside it (right, left or above). Items and prices with the sales tax, a page at a time; banks show their lines.
  • Settings > Taxes & Treasury: turn every screen off; each player sets how far away screens are drawn (kgxat_screen_distance).

Jail batons: Release mode

  • Reload on the Police or Admin Jail Baton switches Jail / Beat / Release: a hit lets a jailed player out, also through the bars. The police let out those the police jailed; the admin baton anyone below your rank.
  • Settings > Police & Crime: a Release setting for each baton.

entry.title: KGX's Admin Toolbox v3.6.21.4.1: Fireworks Fix
entry.summary: Fixes Fireworks did not show at all. They are now sent to every player and drawn by the toolbox itself: rockets, the seven shapes, fountains and shows work again. Property tax : the treasury window now says what it is doing: how many bought properties are taxed, when the next one
entry.content:
Fixes

  • Fireworks did not show at all. They are now sent to every player and drawn by the toolbox itself: rockets, the seven shapes, fountains and shows work again.
  • Property tax: the treasury window now says what it is doing: how many bought properties are taxed, when the next one is due and how many owners are offline (they pay when back), or why nothing is taxed (economy off, RP mode or Property off, DarkRP, or only rented / server property owned: those pay none).
  • Property tax: a property sold and bought again starts its own period instead of keeping the old owner's due time.
  • Fireworks: black as the color now means a random color (black was invisible); rocket trails no longer grow with the frame rate.

Money Log and treasury

  • Utilities > Money Log: Copy the shown changes to the clipboard, and Clear the whole Money Log... for superadmins (asks first; balances do not change).
  • Treasury window: Copy the log and, for superadmins, Clear the log... as buttons next to Refresh.

entry.title: KGX's Admin Toolbox v3.6.21.4: The Mayor
entry.summary: New: the Mayor (Settings > Mayor & Laws) A Mayor ability for jobs, and a ready-made Mayor job (Settings > Jobs > Add a preset job). Laws : !addlaw , !removelaw , !resetlaws ; everyone reads them with !laws . The server's own laws (with six example laws to start from) come back wh
entry.content:
New: the Mayor (Settings > Mayor & Laws)

  • A Mayor ability for jobs, and a ready-made Mayor job (Settings > Jobs > Add a preset job).
  • Laws: !addlaw <law>, !removelaw <number>, !resetlaws; everyone reads them with !laws. The server's own laws (with six example laws to start from) come back when no mayor is left.
  • Law boards: !placelaws puts the laws on a board where the Mayor aims; admins' boards stay on the map.
  • Lockdowns: !lockdown [why] sounds a siren and tells everyone to get inside; !unlockdown ends it.
  • Wanted: !wanted <name>, <why> puts WANTED over their head until they are arrested or it runs out; the police may use it too.
  • Search warrants: !warrant <name>, <why> lets the police open that player's property doors for a while.
  • Mayor buttons in the ATB window (also as HUD shortcuts). Off on DarkRP unless you turn it on (DarkRP has its own).

entry.title: KGX's Admin Toolbox v3.6.21.3: HUD Shortcuts
entry.summary: ATB window (hold C) HUD shortcuts : drag any ATB button out of the window onto your screen (or right-click it > Add to my HUD). Hold C to click them. Move mode to drag them around, right-click to remove; names, size and "only while holding C" in its Settings tab. New buttons: Tre
entry.content:
ATB window (hold C)

  • HUD shortcuts: drag any ATB button out of the window onto your screen (or right-click it > Add to my HUD). Hold C to click them. Move mode to drag them around, right-click to remove; names, size and "only while holding C" in its Settings tab.
  • New buttons: Treasury (admins and Treasury jobs like a Mayor), Phone Book, Mail, and Revive the dead where they died (Server tab).
  • Settings > Tool Visibility can hide each ATB button from players or show it only to some ranks, jobs or licenses. Admins always see the window and every button, also while incognito.
  • Right-click a Treasury Node in the C menu: Open the treasury.

New tools

  • Fun > Fireworks: rockets that burst into colors (sphere, ring, willow, crackle, two colors, heart, star), spark fountains and whole shows. Light only, they hurt nobody.
  • Cheats > Revive: bring dead players back where they died, with their weapons and ammo.

Player Manager

  • New: Health & weapons (heal, set health / armor, give a weapon, revive), Move them (return, teleport to where you aim, unstick, out of their vehicle, launch), on fire, and copy name / SteamID64 / open their Steam profile.

Fixes

  • Property tax often never came: every Apply on the Taxes page restarted the one countdown for all properties. Now each property is taxed one period after it was bought, the treasury window shows when the next one is due, and admins can charge it now.
  • Small transfers no longer get a fee rounded away to nothing.
  • E on a bank vault now opens a window with its money and whether it can be robbed. Money source signs show cents.
  • Lights whose size was changed can be removed (R), changed and copied with the tool again.
  • The HUD card grows with long names and big money so text never overlaps; the bank moves to its own line if it still does not fit.

entry.title: KGX's Admin Toolbox v3.6.21.2: Phone Book
entry.summary: New: Phone Book (!phone, key P, F3 hub > Phone) Every player on the server in one list. Call anyone: a private voice call between the two of you, wherever you are. They answer in a popup or with their phone key; a bar on top of the screen shows the call. Texts to players (offline
entry.content:
New: Phone Book (!phone, key P, F3 hub > Phone)

  • Every player on the server in one list. Call anyone: a private voice call between the two of you, wherever you are. They answer in a popup or with their phone key; a bar on top of the screen shows the call.
  • Texts to players (offline too) and to groups, with unread counts. Missed calls leave a text.
  • Buddies and a status: Available, Buddies only or Do not disturb.
  • Groups with their own chat and voice channel: Everyone, Admins only, Police only, picked ranks, picked jobs, or Invite only.
  • Your own phone needs the new Phone License (a setting); phone booths work for everyone.
  • Settings > Phone Book: costs for calls, minutes, texts and booth calls, ring time, longest call, private calls, who makes groups and more. Admins see every group and call and can end calls, remove members and delete groups.

New: Phone Booth (World > Phone Booth)

  • A pay phone, or an invisible node on a map's own phone, with a "PHONE (E)" sign. Saved for the map.

Bank vaults

  • New setting (on by default): banks and ATMs set as a bank vault only hold money. Nobody, admins too, deposits or withdraws there; they can still be robbed.

Eye scanners

  • The Mechanical & Digital Bypass can break into eye scanners. Each scanner picks how: Keypad Hacker, the Bypass (either click, mechanical only, digital only, or mechanical then digital), any of them, or nothing; with its own time and chance.
  • Server settings in Settings > Lockpick & Hacking. The scanner's sign is now centered.

Other

  • Inside panels and tools, settings added in a recent update have a green name and changed ones a yellow name, until you move the mouse over them.

entry.title: KGX's Admin Toolbox v3.6.21.1: Eye Scanner
entry.summary: New: Eye Scanner (Building > Eye Scanner) A Combine button that scans your eye and opens its linked doors for the players, jobs (Mayor, Police...) and ranks you pick - like a keypad without a code. Settings on the scanner itself (Shift + E, its owner and admins): who may pass, sc
entry.content:
New: Eye Scanner (Building > Eye Scanner)

  • A Combine button that scans your eye and opens its linked doors for the players, jobs (Mayor, Police...) and ranks you pick - like a keypad without a code.
  • Settings on the scanner itself (Shift + E, its owner and admins): who may pass, scan time, open time, lockdown, alarms to you and the police, sounds, hackable or not, and the last scans.
  • Server scanners are saved for the map; admins' Alt + E access works on them like on keypads.

New: Lights (Building > Lights)

  • Glowing shapes in any size and color that light the world: ball, cube, panel, disc, cone, tube light or an invisible point.
  • Effects (pulse, flicker, strobe, color cycle, fade, candle) and motion (bob, circle, figure 8, wander, spin). Move them with the physgun.
  • Hide the body so only the light shows (it shows while you hold the tool gun). Server lights for admins.
  • Safety settings (Settings > Lights): size, brightness and reach caps, flash limits, and each player can turn flashing off for themselves.

Other

  • The tool list marks NEW tools in green and UPDATED ones in yellow until you open them.
  • Banks made with the Store Maker are a vault by default; more bank and treasury models to pick from.

entry.title: KGX's Admin Toolbox v3.6.21: Treasury Robberies
entry.summary: Treasury, banks and robberies New tool: Economy > Treasury Node - put the server treasury in the world, as a vault or an invisible node. Robbing it takes a share of the treasury (you set the share, the most, how it is robbed and the cooldown). Admins and Treasury jobs press E on
entry.content:
Treasury, banks and robberies

  • New tool: Economy > Treasury Node - put the server treasury in the world, as a vault or an invisible node. Robbing it takes a share of the treasury (you set the share, the most, how it is robbed and the cooldown). Admins and Treasury jobs press E on it to open the treasury.
  • Bank vaults: banks and ATMs can hold a share of every tax and fee (Store Maker > Bank vault: on, its share %, the most it holds). Set how much goes to the banks in Settings > Taxes & Treasury > Bank vaults %. Robbers take it; turning a vault off gives its money back to the treasury.
  • Money Generator: choose where a source's money comes from - its own, a bank vault, or the treasury itself.
  • The treasury window shows the money in the bank vaults.

Currencies

  • Pick a currency in Settings > Economy: Dollar, Euro, Pound, Yen, Peso, Real, Ruble, Rupee, Franc, Yuan, Bitcoin, Credits, Coins, Gold, Gems, Tokens, Bucks, Bottle caps, Chips - or type your own.
  • Amounts in words always show the cents, like a check: [i]One Million Dollars and 00/100[/i].

entry.title: KGX's Admin Toolbox v3.6.20.3: Cents
entry.summary: Money boxes take cents (Settings > Economy > Cents) Every money amount you type now takes cents ($12.50): starting money, paychecks (normal, cap, per rank, per job, Unemployed), the transfer fee minimum and Treasury job limit, store and shipment prices, the price of one in a ship
entry.content:
Money boxes take cents (Settings > Economy > Cents)

  • Every money amount you type now takes cents ($12.50): starting money, paychecks (normal, cap, per rank, per job, Unemployed), the transfer fee minimum and Treasury job limit, store and shipment prices, the price of one in a shipment store, loadout prices, money printers (money per print, black market prices), money sources, mail cost, pickpocket limit, cigarette price, the Money, Property, Vehicle Pad and Money Printer tools, and Talking NPC / Logic money.
  • With Cents off the boxes stay whole. Prices saved with cents keep them and are charged whole until Cents is back on.
  • Economy percentages (death drop, taxes, bank interest, the dealer's share, buy-back, robbery share) take two decimals.

Fixes

  • Big money settings (up to 100,000,000) are now saved and read exactly.
  • A shipment's box of one could cost one more than it should (e.g. 100 instead of 99).
  • Losing a property by leaving its job now refunds half of what you paid (minus unpaid property tax), like selling it.

entry.title: KGX's Admin Toolbox v3.6.20.2: Treasury Log
entry.summary: Treasury log (!treasury) A clear log in the treasury window: every deposit, withdrawal, tax and payment with the balance after it, who did it and when. Hover a line to see the amounts in words. Superadmins right-click the log: add a note line, add or edit a note on any line, take
entry.content:
Treasury log (!treasury)

  • A clear log in the treasury window: every deposit, withdrawal, tax and payment with the balance after it, who did it and when. Hover a line to see the amounts in words.
  • Superadmins right-click the log: add a note line, add or edit a note on any line, take an admin's deposit back, remove a line, or clear the log. The balance never changes from removing or clearing, and the Money Log keeps every change.
  • Admins deposit and withdraw from the boxes at the bottom or by right-clicking the log. Everyone can copy a line, its amount or the amount in words.
  • Amounts in words, like a check: type 1000000 and it shows [i]One Million Dollars[/i] under the box (in the bank window too).
  • Refresh button, and Live: an open treasury window updates by itself when money comes in or goes out.

Cents (Settings > Economy)

  • New setting: money can have cents ($12.50) in wallets, banks, !give, transfers, dropped cash, taxes, interest, the treasury and the Money Log. Off by default; never with DarkRP money.

entry.title: KGX's Admin Toolbox v3.6.20.1: Website Moved
entry.summary: Toolbox website moved to GitHub Pages: the F3 hub's "Toolbox website" button opens the new address. The site now has a page for every tutorial and works on phones.
entry.content: • Toolbox website moved to GitHub Pages: the F3 hub's "Toolbox website" button opens the new address. The site now has a page for every tutorial and works on phones.

entry.title: KGX's Admin Toolbox v3.6.20: Taxes & Treasury
entry.summary: Taxes & Treasury (Settings > Taxes & Treasury) New taxes and fees (all off by default): income tax on paychecks, sales tax on top of store and shipment prices, a transfer fee on !give and bank transfers, and property tax on bought property (unpaid too often = sold back). Server t
entry.content:
Taxes & Treasury (Settings > Taxes & Treasury)

  • New taxes and fees (all off by default): income tax on paychecks, sales tax on top of store and shipment prices, a transfer fee on !give and bank transfers, and property tax on bought property (unpaid too often = sold back).
  • Server treasury: taxes and fees go into it (or out of the economy, your choice). Admins and jobs with the new Treasury ability (a Mayor) pay players out of it with a reason: !treasury.
  • Every tax, fee and payment is its own source in the Money Log; the treasury shows there as "Treasury".

Money Log rollbacks (Utilities > Money Log)

  • Right-click a change: undo it (or several selected changes), or roll the player back to right before or after it (wallet and bank).
  • A preview shows every balance now and after; nothing changes until Apply. Never below 0; offline players for superadmins only.
  • Every rollback is listed and can be undone. Rolled-back changes cannot be undone twice.

Other

  • Paycheck, !give and bank transfer messages show in each player's language.

entry.title: KGX's Admin Toolbox v3.6.19: Translations
entry.summary: Translations New: the toolbox's player screens come in English, Español, Deutsch, Français, Русский and Português (Brasil) : the HUD, the F3 hub, the loadout screen, Create a Class, votes, the match HUD (scoreboard, end screens, objectives, kill feed, Waves, buy stations, Traitor
entry.content:
Translations

  • New: the toolbox's player screens come in English, Español, Deutsch, Français, Русский and Português (Brasil): the HUD, the F3 hub, the loadout screen, Create a Class, votes, the match HUD (scoreboard, end screens, objectives, kill feed, Waves, buy stations, Traitors, Murder, Hide and Seek and the other modes), the XP popup and the match and vote messages.
  • Each player in their own language: the server picks the default (or Auto: each player's Garry's Mod language), and each player can pick their own in Settings > Display > Language. Messages from the server show in every player's own language.
  • New: Settings > Translations - every phrase with its translation. The owner can change any phrase (English too), add a language of their own and copy a language as JSON. Edits reach everyone right away.
  • Admin panels stay English for now; they follow in a later update. Logs, the Action Log and saved files stay English.

entry.title: KGX's Admin Toolbox v3.6.18.1: Loadout Look
entry.summary: Loadout screen and Create a Class: your character now shows on the right, holding the primary weapon (drag to turn it). A switch shows the model you spawn with (the loadout's or class's model) or your own player model. Smaller weapon previews with the stat bars right beside them;
entry.content:
• Loadout screen and Create a Class: your character now shows on the right, holding the primary weapon (drag to turn it). A switch shows the model you spawn with (the loadout's or class's model) or your own player model.
  • Smaller weapon previews with the stat bars right beside them; the screens keep sensible sizes on big and ultra-wide monitors.
  • Favorites: the Setup Wizard is in the server owner's Favorites by default.

entry.title: KGX's Admin Toolbox v3.6.18: Setup Wizard
entry.summary: Setup Wizard (Settings > Setup Wizard) New: pick what kind of server you run - Sandbox, Build / PvP, Roleplay (RP), Arena (PVP) or Survival (PVE) - and the toolbox sets itself up: server mode, Game Modes and their rotation, the spawn menu for players, the HUD & Hub preset and saf
entry.content:
Setup Wizard (Settings > Setup Wizard)

  • New: pick what kind of server you run - Sandbox, Build / PvP, Roleplay (RP), Arena (PVP) or Survival (PVE) - and the toolbox sets itself up: server mode, Game Modes and their rotation, the spawn menu for players, the HUD & Hub preset and safe Player Access tools for all players.
  • Every change is listed first (now / after). Nothing changes until you press Apply, and Apply makes a backup first.
  • Next steps on this map: shows the hub spots, spawns, enemy spawns, buy stations or jobs the map still needs.
  • Opens by itself for the owner on a new install. Run it again any time. Owner only.

entry.title: KGX's Admin Toolbox v3.6.17.1: Preview Key
entry.summary: Hover preview (the model at the cursor in lists and the spawn menu): its on/off switch moved to Settings > Display (themes). Your saved choice stays. New key: Hover preview on/off (Settings > Keybinds, F7 recommended). Works with the spawn menu open, not while typing. F7 has no d
entry.content:
• Hover preview (the model at the cursor in lists and the spawn menu): its on/off switch moved to Settings > Display (themes). Your saved choice stays.
  • New key: Hover preview on/off (Settings > Keybinds, F7 recommended). Works with the spawn menu open, not while typing. F7 has no default bind in Garry's Mod and no other toolbox or Throw Equipped key uses it.

entry.title: KGX's Admin Toolbox v3.6.17: Waves & Survival
entry.summary: PVE: Waves and Survival New special rule: Waves (PVE) in Utilities > Game Modes. Everyone together against waves of NPCs that grow and get tougher. Points for hits and kills, the fallen come back when a wave is cleared, the match ends when nobody is standing. New built-in mode: S
entry.content:
PVE: Waves and Survival

  • New special rule: Waves (PVE) in Utilities > Game Modes. Everyone together against waves of NPCs that grow and get tougher. Points for hits and kills, the fallen come back when a wave is cleared, the match ends when nobody is standing.
  • New built-in mode: Survival - endless zombie waves; players pick a loadout or their custom class.
  • New Mode Spots kind: Enemy spawn - where the waves come from.
  • AI: wave NPCs only hunt the players in the match (hub players and the map's NPCs are left alone), always go for the nearest player, are not made to flee or surrender by the AI Brain, are replaced when stuck, and are removed when the match ends.
  • Fair play: players who join mid-wave wait for the next wave (no damage, no points); headcrabs from wave zombies count as enemies; stuck or idle enemies are replaced; NPC kills do not count as Match stats kills.
  • HUD: wave, enemies left, break countdown; token {x:wave}. Achievements: Hold the Line (wave 10), Last One Out (wave 25).

Buy Stations (World > Buy Stations, admins only)

  • Wall weapons (buy again for ammo), a mystery box, perk machines, door buys and switches that fire logic. Players press E and pay with their points. Saved per map.

Other

  • Game Modes > Loadouts: Off, Server loadouts, Armory (players' own classes only) or Both.
  • Game Modes editor: hovering a cut-off option name now shows it in full (also in the other toolbox windows).
  • Scoreboard: the Job column no longer says "Unassigned". It shows PVP player or PVE player on arena servers, the job on RP, Builder / PvP on Build servers.
  • Create a Class now closes with F3 (Esc opens the game menu again).

entry.title: KGX's Admin Toolbox v3.6.16: Armory
entry.summary: Armory and Create-a-Class New: Settings > Armory - the weapons and perks players build their own classes from (Primary, Secondary, Melee, Lethal, Tactical, three perks). Each item is free, unlocks at a level, or is unlocked for good with match credits; it can be limited to some m
entry.content:
Armory and Create-a-Class

  • New: Settings > Armory - the weapons and perks players build their own classes from (Primary, Secondary, Melee, Lethal, Tactical, three perks). Each item is free, unlocks at a level, or is unlocked for good with match credits; it can be limited to some modes and given its own stat bars.
  • Match credits for finishing matches, winning and kills. Admins can give or take them (kgxat_credits). New HUD token {credits}.
  • Create a Class: a full-screen editor in the style of Call of Duty with your classes, each slot's items and their stats, unlocks right there. F4 in the hub, CREATE A CLASS on the loadout screen, the F3 hub, or a Talking NPC ("Open the Armory").
  • Game modes can offer players' custom classes next to the preset loadouts.
  • Perks: Lightweight, Vitality, Armor Plate, High Jump, Flak Jacket, Scavenger, Fast Healing, Dead Silence, Bandolier, or any buff. They only work in matches.

entry.content:
Arena: hub, loadouts per game mode, loadout screen

  • Fix: weapons from a match could be taken out of it (backpack, pockets, containers, vaults, or sold to a store). During a match these, shipments and Talking NPC gear rewards now wait until it ends; weapons dropped in a match are only for match players and are removed when it ends.
  • Hub: place Hub spots with World > Mode Spots. Players outside a match spawn there with only their hands and cannot get hurt; after every match everyone comes back to the hub with what they had there. Admin Events still work. Without hub spots nothing changes.
  • Loadouts per game mode: Player Loadouts can be for outside matches, any match or one mode (new Game mode column). Modes can let players pick a loadout: it gives the weapons in hotbar order, the class keeps its health and model. Options: screen in the lobby, change during the match or locked, empty hands or holding it in the lobby, paid once with match money.
  • New loadout screen in the style of Call of Duty, also for F4: weapon models, stat bars (damage, fire rate, range, accuracy, mobility, control), equipment, the class, a timer, Equip / Use current / Show current / Skip.
  • HUD & Hub: built-in PVP (arena) and PVE (waves) presets, a Loadouts tab in the F3 hub, tokens {level} {loadout} {matchmoney} {team} {match} {next}.

entry.content:
Game Modes: next match, balance and seasons

  • Next match by itself (Utilities > Game Modes > Settings, off by default): after a match, and when the map starts, the next lobby opens on its own. Players vote on the next mode, or it follows the rotation, or it is random. Only modes the map can run and with enough players online; untick a mode's "In the next-mode vote and rotation" to leave it out. Every few matches it can be a map vote instead. "Next match now" skips the wait. Not on RP servers (matches are events there).
  • Team balance by skill: teams can be evened by level or by match win rate. Sizes stay equal, the strongest players are spread out, and balancing moves the player that evens it best.
  • Leaderboard seasons: Leaderboards show All time, This season or an ended season. When a season ends (after a set number of days, or a superadmin's End the season) its top 25 are archived, the best player gets the new Season Champion badge and the top three Podium, and the season boards start again. Levels, achievements and cosmetics stay.

entry.content:
Blank start: wipe map data

  • New: the reset window (Settings > Server Settings > Reset everything / wipe map data..., owners) can also delete saved data: this map's world data, the world data of every map, or everything the toolbox saved (like a fresh install).
  • World data: warps, zones, signs, spawn points, spawners, teleporters, stores, containers, permanent props, map doors, server keypads, buttons and cameras, chairs, logic, sounds, notes, decals, properties, NPC paths, media screens, robbery and vault spots.
  • Everything also clears money and bank, backpacks, vaults, stats, XP, licenses, mail, loot tables, prefabs, rules and reports. Ranks / staff and bans / warnings are kept unless you untick them; the owner list and backups are never deleted. Logs only when ticked.
  • A backup of everything is saved first, so Settings > Backup / Restore undoes it. Nothing is saved again until the map restarts 10 seconds later, then the map loads blank. Type WIPE to confirm.
  • Server console / rcon: kgxat_wipedata map|allmaps|everything confirm

entry.content:
Money Log

  • New: Utilities > Money Log - every wallet and bank change: who, how much, the balance after, and where the money came from (paycheck, bank, admin and which admin, cash pickup with where that cash came from, stores, printers, property, logic, talking NPCs and more).
  • Search by day, player, source and size. A per-player day summary (in, out, net, mostly from), biggest gain first, so a dupe stands out in a day instead of a wipe.
  • Money alerts: a player gaining a lot in a short time (default 50,000 in 10 minutes) is shown to admins at once. Admin gifts do not count.
  • Kept per day for 14 days (kgxat_moneylog_days). Console: kgxat_moneylog <name or SteamID>. Players can be given the panel in Player Access.

Media fixes

  • Fix: screens and radios could all stay black ("GetChannel (a nil value)" in the console when a screen came into view).
  • Fix: YouTube on screens showed black; now only its player fills the screen. Option: show YouTube's whole page (Utilities > Media & Radio).
  • Fullscreen in pages works on more sites.

entry.title: KGX's Admin Toolbox v3.6.12.1: Spawn Whitelist
entry.summary: New: Settings > Spawn Whitelist - players spawn from the spawn menu only what is listed: single items, whole folders or spawn menu categories, or a whole game's models, for everyone or chosen ranks and jobs. Each kind (models, entities, weapons, NPCs, vehicles) can be freed. Righ
entry.content:
• New: Settings > Spawn Whitelist - players spawn from the spawn menu only what is listed: single items, whole folders or spawn menu categories, or a whole game's models, for everyone or chosen ranks and jobs. Each kind (models, entities, weapons, NPCs, vehicles) can be freed. Right-click any spawn menu icon > Spawn whitelist to add it. Off by default (kgxat_spawn_whitelist).
  • Job equip (Settings > Gameplay): taking a job now dissolves the player and respawns them where they stood, so the new job's gear always comes with a fresh spawn (no drops, no death count). Also Instant death, Instant loadout (the old way) or Off.
  • Movement speeds for every player (Settings > Gameplay): walk, run, slow walk (0 = the gamemode's).
  • Pickpocketing: a real chance shown while you crouch (behind them, their facing, moving, cloak), an eye on the HUD that tells you whether someone sees you (never their pockets or money), three methods (minigame, chance, both), and an optional crouch cloak for Pickpocket jobs (visibility, delay, fade-in, chance bonus; more invisible while creeping slower than crouch walking).
  • Poop by a timer (Settings > Gameplay > Poop, off by default): players poop by themselves now and then (every player or only Hobo jobs, timer settings, a warning first). How long poop stays on the ground and the most on the map. E on a poop: eat it, pick it up or pick it up and hold it. Poop on the ground cannot be thrown until picked up; one at a time unless your job has the Poop weapon.
  • Storage Vaults are no longer a stash to carry: a placed bought vault goes back into the Pockets only when empty (or never), not right after it was put down, and not into spawn zones. Owners can throw an empty vault away (Alt + E, or !vault remove).
  • Media players and radios: YouTube plays again (YouTube's embedded player refused the game's browser: Error 153). New Internet setting for screens and for radios: Restricted (YouTube, YouTube Music, Spotify and the sites you list) or Full (any public website). Screens now show web pages (Twitch, Vimeo...) and play video / audio files; radios play any stream or web player, and a new Stations window searches thousands of radio stations. Local and private addresses never play.
  • Use screens with the cursor, live: E on a screen that plays something gives you the cursor on it. Clicks, scrolling and typing are shared with everyone watching (others' cursors show with names), with Back / Forward / Reload / Home and an optional address bar on the screen. Radios open a window that works the same way. Owners pick who may use the page.
  • Device settings (live): brightness, sharpness, fit, title bar, glow, volume, range, loudness by distance, who may click, typing, scrolling. Your own screen / radio volume, Mute for me, Hide for me.
  • New: TV Remote (Weapons > ATB): left click on a TV, screen or radio from far away is like pressing E on it; a red laser pointer shows where you aim (right click: on / off). Held like a pistol, only the remote shows. Admins can limit it to admins or block players from having one.
  • Media and radio optimized: smoother cursor on screens, lighter page updates, settings with Apply buttons, fullscreen videos (a page's own fullscreen button works, plus a Fullscreen video button). Fix: a radio could keep playing after being turned off or removed. Fix: YouTube on screens now fills the screen and follows volume, pause and seeking; clicks land exactly where your cursor (now drawn on the screen) points. Fix: live internet radio streams no longer error ("SetTime on a block streamed audio channel"); a problem with one screen or radio no longer stops the others. Fix: signs no longer show through screens.
  • Browser: type any address or a search; the address bar no longer gets overwritten while you type.
  • Version line also shows each player's game build and branch.
  • Third person: hold the key and move the mouse to turn the camera 360 around you (a tap still switches it on / off).
  • New: a small, faint line at the bottom right of the screen: "KGX's Admin Toolbox v3.6.12.1 | Server <version>", on by default. Settings > HUD & Hub turns it off and sets your server's own version; each player can hide it in Settings > Display.
  • Fix: searching the tool list (Quick Filter) no longer flickers.
  • Fix: poop can no longer be pocketed, carried, thrown away (Throw Equipped) or picked up by players who cannot use it (Pickup Equipped).
